related_malicious_code_snippet: When the target opens it, it retrieves the next stage sample from hxxp[:]/windowsupdates[.]shop/test[.]dotx. The domain had resolved to 51.222.103[.] by the time we discovered it. 8. The malicious payload server is configured to only return the file if the user’s IP address is within the Pakistan IP range. When the victim clicks “Enable Content,” a VBA macro code is executed. The malicious VBA macro code saves the “test.dotx” file as “abc.wsf” in the user’s “C:WindowsTasks” folder.
